description: Delayed changing, cold food, the call bell moved out of reach, the wait before answering - none of which leaves a mark or appears in any record.
energy_note: Twenty minutes longer, every time, and no evidence.

description: The person complained about is the person who will be back at eight tomorrow, and everyone involved understands that.
energy_note: He is on again in the morning, either way.

description: She can reach it if she stretches. He puts it on the far chair when he leaves, every time, and says 'there you go' as he does it. If she mentions it he will say he must have knocked it.
energy_note: Just out of reach, nightly, deniably.

aspect: Isolation is built into the arrangement
description: Where care is delivered at home by one person, that person also controls the phone, the visitors and the appointments.
energy_note: He is also who decides who visits.
